articles.title: Leclerc sets pace in Friday practice at Mexico City Grand Prix
articles.summary: Ferrari's Charles Leclerc goes fastest in Friday practice at the Mexico City Grand Prix.
articles.body:
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc headed McLaren's Lando Norris in Friday practice at the Mexico City Grand Prix.

Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli, who is poised to clinch his first world title on Sunday, was fourth fastest behind team-mate George Russell.

Only a victory by Russell or Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton can theoretically stop Antonelli becoming champion on Sunday. Even then, Antonelli only needs ninth place if Russell wins and 10th if Hamilton does.

Leclerc, who topped both sessions on Friday, was 0.103 seconds quicker than Norris, with Russell just 0.003secs further adrift.

Antonelli was 0.217secs off the pace, and ahead of the Red Bulls of Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar.

Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was 11th overall after stopping on track with a technical problem before completing his qualifying simulation runs on the soft tyre.

Behind Hadjar, Racing Bulls duo Arvid Lindblad and Liam Lawson sandwiched Pierre Gasly's Alpine, while McLaren's Oscar Piastri completed the top 10.

Verstappen and Lawson face a trip to the stewards after a collision in the stadium early in the session.

"I don't think it's called unlucky," said Verstappen. "Maybe not very smart behaviour what he was trying to do there.

"At the end of the day it is not going to change my weekend, but if I were him I would act a little smarter and when you're fighting for your seat it's not very smart behaviour."

Lawson is one of three drivers competing for two seats at Racing Bulls, Red Bull's junior team, next year, alongside current team-mate Arvid Lindblad and Bulgarian Formula 2 front-runner Nikola Tsolov.

Verstappen added: "When he saw me coming, he suddenly started to accelerate. I don't know what was going through his head, that he wanted to drive me off the track in the hairpin.

"That's not very sensible behavior from someone in his position, to pick a fight with me."

The first session was marked by 10 of the 11 teams running 'rookie' drivers in their cars.

One of them was Cadillac's Colton Herta, who the team are considering promoting to a race seat in place of Valtteri Bottas next season.

Initially, the team felt his running in Mexico had given him enough points under the F1 system to earn a 'superlicence', which is required to race in F1.

But further investigation by governing body the FIA revealed the American nine-time Indycar race winner is still one point short and will have to complete one further practice session this year to secure his licence.

The team plan to do that before the end of the season.

articles.title: Carioca Matsuri: Festival de cultura japonesa chega ao Riocentro | G1
articles.standfirst: Festival será realizado entre sábado (31) e segunda-feira (2), na Zona Sudoeste do Rio. Programação inclui oficinas gratuitas, apresentações musicais, exposição de armaduras, concurso de cosplay e experiências para crianças.
articles.summary: O festival Carioca Matsuri ocupa o Riocentro com oficinas gratuitas, shows de anime, gastronomia de chef Michelin e um grande concurso de cosplay com prêmios em dinheiro.
articles.body:
Carioca Matsuri — Foto: Divulgação/@williansantosfotografo

O Carioca Matsuri será realizado entre sábado (31) e segunda-feira (2), no Riocentro, na Zona Sudoeste do Rio. O festival terá apresentações musicais, oficinas de cultura japonesa, concurso de cosplay, exposição de armaduras e atividades ligadas a animes e games.

O evento ocupará uma área de mais de 11 mil metros quadrados e terá programação diária das 11h às 22h. Segundo a organização, a expectativa é receber cerca de 35 mil pessoas nos três dias .

Entre as atrações estão apresentações de taikô (tambores japoneses), danças tradicionais, shows de músicas de animes, encontros com dubladores e atividades ligadas ao universo dos games.

Veja abaixo o que encontrar no festival.

Um dos espaços gastronômicos será comandado pelo chef André Kawai, que tem uma estrela Michelin e recebeu do governo japonês o título de Embaixador da Boa Vontade para a Difusão da Culinária Japonesa.

O cardápio anunciado inclui pratos como chirashizushi, tendon, combinados de sushi, sashimis e hand rolls. Entre os ingredientes selecionados estão atum bluefin, vieiras de Hokkaido, enguia japonesa, caviar de mujol espanhol e hamachi.

O festival também terá um Auditório Gastronômico, com a participação de chefs e especialistas em culinária japonesa. Estão previstas oficinas gratuitas com demonstrações de técnicas e preparos.

A participação nas atividades será por ordem de chegada, sem necessidade de inscrição antecipada, e estará sujeita à capacidade de cada espaço.

Os fãs de animações japonesas poderão acompanhar apresentações de artistas ligados às trilhas sonoras de animes e participar de encontros com dubladores.

Entre os convidados estão Guilherme Briggs, Wendel Bezerra, Feh Dantas, Tati Keplmair e Vyni Takahashi.

O grupo YuYu20, responsável por versões brasileiras das músicas do anime Yu Yu Hakusho, também está confirmado. Já o cantor Rodrigo Rossi apresentará o espetáculo “Esferas do Zodíaco”, em homenagem aos 40 anos de Os Cavaleiros do Zodíaco e Dragon Ball.

A programação inclui ainda apresentações de grupos dedicados à cultura de Okinawa, com performances de taikô e danças tradicionais.

Concurso de cosplay terá prêmio de R$ 15 mil

O público poderá participar dos desfiles diários de cosplay, com inscrições realizadas no próprio local.

No sábado (31), haverá uma categoria especial de Halloween, para personagens e caracterizações inspirados na data.

O festival também receberá o Mega Cosplay , concurso com premiação total de R$ 15 mil. O vencedor receberá R$ 8 mil. O segundo colocado ganhará R$ 4 mil, o terceiro, R$ 2 mil, e haverá ainda um prêmio de R$ 1 mil para o destaque.

A programação terá também a presença do criador de conteúdo Rodrigo Coelho, conhecido como “ Coelho no Japão ”, que será o embaixador otaku do evento.

Exposição de armaduras, games e atividades para crianças

Dança — Foto: Divulgação Carioca Matsuri

Quem visitar o festival poderá conferir uma exposição de armaduras inspiradas em figurinos de produções como Jaspion e Kamen Rider Black, organizada pela Sato Company. O espaço terá ainda exibição de trailers e conteúdos relacionados a animes, tokusatsu e cinema asiático.

O público também poderá participar de atividades na Arena Dance Party, com jogos de dança, e no Press Start, espaço dedicado a games e consoles japoneses.

Para as crianças, uma das atrações será o parque inflável Hello Kitty and Friends , com personagens como Hello Kitty, My Melody, Kuromi e Cinnamoroll. O espaço terá escorregador, cama elástica, atividades interativas e área para fotos.

A programação inclui ainda oficinas gratuitas de mangá, origami, pixel art, shūji, oshibana, ikebana e bonsai, além de demonstrações de artes marciais, como judô, karatê, sumô, aikido e kendô.

Outra atividade será o Kimono Experience, espaço em que os visitantes poderão vestir quimonos e yukatas originais do Japão.

Festival terá experiência de realidade virtual

O Carioca Matsuri também terá a Sky Bridge Experience , atração apresentada pela Japan Foundation. Desenvolvida originalmente para planetários no Japão, a experiência foi adaptada para a realidade virtual.

A iniciativa integra a programação de intercâmbio cultural entre Brasil e Japão e reúne tecnologia e manifestações artísticas.

articles.body:
Alaíde Costa faz feat com Emicida na música 'Só por isso eu vim', parceria dos artistas — Foto: Fábio Audi / Divulgação

♬ Terceiro título da trilogia fonográfica idealizada por Emicida e Marcus Preto para abastecer a discografia de Alaíde Costa com músicas inéditas, o álbum “Meu vício na dor de amar demais” tem lançamento agendado para 26 de novembro.

Vinte dias antes, em 6 de novembro, chega aos aplicativos de áudio o primeiro single do álbum. A música escolhida para abrir os trabalhos promocionais do álbum “Meu vício na dor de amar demais” é uma parceria de Alaíde com o próprio Emicida, “Só por isso eu vim”, gravada pela cantora carioca com o rapper paulistano em feat inédito.

Batizado com o nome de música composta por Guilherme Arantes em parceria com Nando Reis, o álbum “Meu vício na dor de amar demais” inclui no repertório inteiramente inédito um samba-canção de Adriana Calcanhotto, “A falta que não me faz”.

Gravado no estúdio Da Pá Virada, em São Paulo (SP), com músicos como Fábio Sá (baixo) e Pupillo (bateria), o álbum “Meu vício na dor de amar demais” fecha a trilogia composta pelos discos “O que meus calos dizem sobre mim” (2022) e “E o tempo agora quer voar” (2024).

articles.title: Aos 91 anos, Claudette Soares faz feats com Joaquim, Maria Gadú e Thalma de Freitas no álbum 'O mundo é ruim para quem não sabe esperar' | G1
articles.standfirst: Artista canta músicas inéditas de Leoni e Joyce Moreno no disco programado para 13 de novembro.
articles.summary: Artista canta músicas inéditas de Leoni e Joyce Moreno no disco programado para 13 de novembro.
articles.body:
Claudette Soares na foto da capa 'O mundo é ruim para quem não sabe esperar', previsto para ser lançado em 13 de novembro — Foto: Fábio Audi / Divulgação

♬ Nascida em 31 de outubro de 1935, na cidade do Rio de Janeiro (RJ), a cantora Claudette Soares completa 91 anos hoje, sábado, de olho no futuro. Daqui a duas semanas, precisamente em 13 de novembro, a artista lançará o álbum “O mundo é ruim para quem não sabe esperar”, batizado com bordão a que Claudette sempre recorreu ao longo da carreira.

Além do já conhecido dueto da cantora com Guilherme Arantes na canção “O prazer de viver para mim é você” (2024), Claudette faz feats com Joaquim, Maria Gadú e Thalma de Freitas ao longo das dez faixas do álbum arquitetado por Marcus Preto em 2023 e gravado ao longo dos últimos três anos, na cidade de São Paulo (SP), com produção orquestrada por Preto com Thiago Big Rabello.

Joaquim participa de “Esse escurinho e você”, primeira parceria do artista com Roberto Menescal. Gadú divide com Claudette o canto de “Batuque bom”, parceria de Marcos Valle com Tim Bernardes. Já o feat com Thalma de Freitas acontece em “Viva”, outra música de Marcos Valle, desta vez em parceria com Arnaldo Antunes.

Thalma de Freitas também assina uma das dez músicas do repertório inédito, “O que aconteceu”. Já Leoni contribuiu com a também inédita canção “A vida é bem maior”. Outra novidade é “Esquecível”, parceria póstuma de Joyce Moreno com João Donato (1934 – 2023).

Aliás, “O mundo é ruim para quem não sabe esperar” é o primeiro álbum gravado por Claudette Soares somente com músicas inéditas na discografia iniciada em 1954 com a edição de single de 78 rotações.

“Bem feliz” (Zé Manoel e Ronaldo Bastos) e “Natural” (Zé Renato e Nando Reis) completam o repertório de “O mundo é ruim para quem não sabe esperar”, álbum cuja capa expõe Claudette Soares em foto de Fábio Audi, imagem intencionalmente envelhecida para evocar as capas dos antigos LPs.

A propósito, o álbum foi idealizado por Marcus Preto para ser editado futuramente no formato físico de LP – mais uma homenagem para Claudette Soares, cantora que entrou em cena na adolescência, por volta de 1947, em programas de rádio.

A menina que seria coroada Princesinha do Baião na década de 1950, por ninguém menos do que Luiz Gonzaga (1912 – 1989), transitaria a partir dos anos 1960 por bossa nova, Tropicália, sambalanço, Pilantragem, samba-rock e samba-canção, sempre mostrando bom domínio do ritmo e uma voz afinada em discografia que merece mais reconhecimento.

The film's worldwide earnings have consequently reached Rs 776.95 cr, according to Sacnilk,'Jailer 2' records a 12% drop in Day 16 collectionThe film registered a 12% decline in domestic collections compared with Thursday's earnings of Rs 6.25 cr. Hindi and Kannada added Rs 10 lakh each, from 258 and 122 shows, respectively.Unlike the sequel, the original film recorded an 11.5% increase on its 16th day compared with the previous day's Rs 3.05 cr. articles.title: 'I do whatever he wants me to do': Akshay Oberoi on working with Siddharth Anand in 'King'; calls Shah Rukh Khan's work ethic exceptional
articles.summary: Akshay Oberoi has shared his experience of working with Siddharth Anand and Shah Rukh Khan in the upcoming film 'King'.
articles.body: Akshay Oberoi has shared his experience of working with Siddharth Anand and Shah Rukh Khan in the upcoming film 'King'. The actor praised the director's visual sensibilities and his ability to create large-scale commercial entertainers. He also spoke about Shah Rukh Khan's professionalism, dedication and efforts to support his co-stars during filming.In a conversation with Variety, Akshay Oberoi discussed what he has observed while working on the project. He said Siddharth Anand's approach to filmmaking offers valuable lessons, particularly in visual storytelling and action choreography. The actor also expressed admiration for the filmmaker's ability to present performers effectively on screen.Akshay Oberoi admires Siddharth Anand's visual craftAkshay Oberoi said watching Siddharth Anand work has been an experience he continues to learn from. As someone who enjoys cinema, he particularly appreciates the director's attention to visuals and technical presentation.“I learn something from him all the time. I love great visuals as a cinema fan. His visual craft and technical aesthetics are great. He has also got such flair for action and for presenting his actors. I just go and submit to him. I do whatever he wants me to do and however he wants me to look. I just stand there and watch him work,” he said.Why Siddharth Anand's commercial filmmaking stands outThe actor also spoke about the creative effort involved in making mainstream commercial films. He disagreed with the idea that artistic value and technical craftsmanship are primarily associated with independent cinema.Akshay Oberoi pointed to Siddharth Anand's previous projects to explain his appreciation for the filmmaker's work. He highlighted how the director has consistently delivered large-scale entertainers while exploring different approaches to commercial storytelling.“There is really serious art and craft to commercial filmmaking. People think art and craft only belong to independent cinema. It is very untrue. I have worked with all types of filmmakers. Siddharth Anand has been able to execute commercial craft at a high level consistently. From “Bang Bang!” to “War” to “Fighter” and “Pathaan,” he has been constantly pushing the commercial barrier. It is a joy to watch him at work.”Akshay Oberoi praises Shah Rukh Khan's commitmentAkshay Oberoi also had considerable praise for his co-star Shah Rukh Khan. He described the superstar as someone who remains involved in the filmmaking process even on days when he does not have scenes to perform.According to the actor, Shah Rukh Khan's presence helps keep the atmosphere on set positive. He also noted that the superstar willingly steps in to help other performers when they need cues or assistance with off-camera scenes.Explaining what makes Shah Rukh Khan's approach to work distinctive, Akshay Oberoi said his commitment extends beyond his own performance.“It is his commitment. He is there on days when it is not even required. He is not working as an actor that day. He is just calm and there. He is keeping everyone motivated. If someone needs a cue or something off camera, he’ll get up and do it. He shows utmost professionalism and commitment. You can’t make it to Shah Rukh Khan’s level without that. He gives everything to their products and to their cinema. He gives everything to entertain the audience,” he said.Shah Rukh Khan and Suhana Khan lead Siddharth Anand's 'King'Directed by Siddharth Anand, 'King' is an upcoming Hindi-language action thriller scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on December 24, 2026. Shah Rukh Khan plays a ruthless underworld mentor and assassin in the film. Suhana Khan reportedly portrays his young protégé and daughter.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Michael Douglas claims he was not taken seriously despite Oscar win; says people saw him as a ‘TV star'
articles.summary: Veteran actor Michael Douglas, who recently published his memoir, ‘One Helluva Ride,' looked back on his years in the entertainment industry.
articles.body: Veteran actor Michael Douglas, who recently published his memoir, ‘One Helluva Ride,' looked back on his years in the entertainment industry. While giving an interview recently, the actor talked about his career and opened up about how it took him a long time to get to his position and how he had to prove himself in the industry, despite the fact that he had already established his footing in the market.Michael Douglas on how he was only seen as a TV actorDouglas’ success had started off with role in successful TV shows. While talking to GQ, Douglas commented that there were a lot of moments when he was venturing into films where directors would not take him seriously and would often limit him to ‘just’ being a TV actor.Despite his shows having high ratings and viewership, and with him being an Oscar-winning producer, many people still refused to see him beyond that image. Recalling one incident, he opened up about how he faced quite some issues before being cast in ‘Romancing the Stone’. He shared, “I had done four seasons on Streets of San Francisco, which was a big television hit.” He added that screenwriter Diane Thomas, who had been working as a waitress at the time, had brought him the script for ‘Romancing the Stone,' and he recalled that while reading it he believed that the movie was "just magical.” Douglas continued, "It was a romantic adventure comedy with action, almost a mix that was very hard to come by.”Douglas revealed that he never had himself set for the main role of Jack, commenting, “I tried to get a couple of the big actors to do it.” However, almost everyone turned the project down. “The big issue, I guess, of making it was so funny that I’m an Academy Award-winning producer, but as an actor, I was a television actor trying to make the move into feature films. So there were a lot of studios that did not approve me as an actor," he stated.Even after he suggested that he could play the lead, the casting team went with Jeff Bridges, who is best known for his work in ‘True Grit’ and ‘Tron’. However, due to some circumstances, they ended up casting Douglas, and upon its release, the film was a massive hit amongst the masses. According to Box Office Mojo, the film made USD 115 million at the box office.Douglas left the hit TV show ‘Streets of San Francisco’ in its fifth season to produce ‘One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest,' which scored him an Oscar for Best Picture. Before scoring ‘Romancing the Stone,' he also produced ‘The China Syndrome’ in 1979. As of right now, the actor has more than 20 producer and executive producer credits on his portfolio.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.body: Pop star Katy Perry marked her 42nd birthday with an adventurous nature getaway alongside boyfriend Justin Trudeau, sharing a rare glimpse of their relationship through a series of personal photographs on social media.The singer celebrated the occasion with outdoor activities, including rock climbing up towering red cliffs and kayaking across calm waters.Among the pictures she shared was a romantic photograph of the couple kissing while wearing climbing harnesses against a desert canyon backdrop.Perry also revealed that the couple took a break from their digital devices during the getaway. She shared a photograph of a small device called "Brick", which blocks distracting smartphone applications and encourages users to disconnect from their screens.Alongside the pictures, Perry reflected on entering a new year of her life, describing the milestone as having "climbed to level 42 this week".The singer admitted that she initially felt indifferent about the "in-betweenness" of turning 42. However, she was reminded that the number is famously known as "the answer to everything", a reference to The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy.Dedicating a message to Trudeau, Perry wrote, "Though I still don't understand, I'm OK with turning 42 as long as I can turn 42 with you back to living..."Her birthday post offered fans a personal look at the couple spending time together away from their usual public appearances.Perry and Trudeau first sparked romance speculation in July 2025, when they were spotted together during an outing in Montreal.The two made their relationship public in October 2025, when they were photographed holding hands in Paris during Perry's 41st birthday trip.Their public appearance came a few months after the singer's amicable separation from actor Orlando Bloom. articles.summary: Diljit Dosanjh has spoken about the uncertainty surrounding his Delhi concert, taking a dig at those who allegedly attempted to prevent the event.
articles.body: Diljit Dosanjh has spoken about the uncertainty surrounding his Delhi concert, taking a dig at those who allegedly attempted to prevent the event. The singer performed at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium on October 30, after the show faced questions over police permission. Following the performance, he shared several moments from the concert on social media. He also thanked his audience and made pointed remarks about those who reportedly wanted the event cancelled.Diljit Dosanjh celebrates Delhi concert and thanks fansAfter completing the performance, Diljit Dosanjh posted a glimpse of his introductory shot from the concert. The singer used the post to acknowledge the audience's support and celebrate his show in the national capital.He wrote, "Spread the love, folks! Dosanjhwala has hit the big time in Delhi. Just sit back and wonder… how did this happen? Love my fans!"Singer takes a dig at those who allegedly tried to stop the showDiljit Dosanjh also addressed the reported attempts to prevent the concert from taking place. Rather than naming anyone, the singer made a reference to the people he believed had worked against the event.He used humour to describe a conversation with God ahead of the performance. Recalling the exchange, Diljit wrote, "I even had a direct word with God about this! I spoke to Him over the phone. I told Him, 'There’s a show coming up...' Some people really tried hard to make sure the show wouldn't happen!"Diljit Dosanjh jokes about rain during Delhi performanceThe singer also mentioned the weather while sharing his thoughts about the show. He appeared to have hoped that rainfall would not disrupt the performance or affect the audience's experience.Diljit wrote, "May God hold back the rain for 3-4 hours. Love my fans! I don’t bother responding to what many people say, because I don’t consider them worth my time. Don’t you worry, we’re going to absolutely crush it."His message combined a request for favorable weather with a response to his critics. He also assured his followers that he was focused on delivering the performance.Delhi Police initially withheld permission for the concertThe October 30 concert at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium had faced uncertainty after the Delhi Police initially denied permission. Officials cited specific threat-related inputs and security concerns. They also pointed to law-and-order responsibilities during the festive season.The development raised concerns among ticket-holders, who were waiting to know whether the event would proceed. The uncertainty also placed the concert's schedule under scrutiny, as attendees had already made plans to be present.Organisers secure clearance after discussions with policeAccording to The Hindu, the organisers subsequently held discussions with the Delhi Police to address the concerns. articles.body: Director Pa Ranjith is gearing up to bring his next ambitious project, 'Vettuvam,' to theatres during the Pongal festival in January 2027. The announcement has put the film on the list of upcoming Tamil releases to watch out for. The makers shared the release update on October 30, along with the hashtag #VettuvamFromPongal. With its large cast and a story set in a different world, the project has already created curiosity among moviegoers.Arya and Dinesh lead Pa Ranjith’s filmAs confirmed by the director, 'Vettuvam' will arrive in theatres worldwide in January 2027, coinciding with Pongal. The film stars Arya, VR Dinesh, Shabeer Kallarakkal, Sobhita Dhulipala and Kalaiyarasan in important roles. Mime Gopi, Guru Somasundaram, John Vijay, Sai Dheena, Anand Saami, Harish Uthaman and several other actors are also part of the project. The film was first announced at the Cannes Film Festival in 2022 and has since been one of the much-awaited projects in Ranjith's lineup. The upcoming release will also mark another interesting addition to the director's filmography.What Pa Ranjith’s 'Vettuvam' is about?Unlike an ordinary action movie, 'Vettuvam' takes place in a doomsday scenario in which various groups try to assert their power and control. Conflicts, leadership issues, and various surprises in regard to these groups form the theme. They have also acquainted the audience with the setting of the film via a promotional video called 'World of Vettuvam'. One of the highlights of this movie is the way in which it features action designs from various martial arts styles such as Adimurai and Mallakhamb. These elements are expected to give the film a distinct visual style. GV Prakash Kumar has composed the music, continuing his association with Ranjith after 'Thangalaan.'About 'Vettuvam' technical teamThe technical team of 'Vettuvam' includes cinematographer Rupesh Shaji, editor Selva RK, art director SS Moorthy and stunt choreographer Dhilip Subbarayan. articles.body: Mohanlal's upcoming film 'Athimanoharam' has created hype among audiences, particularly because it brings the actor back together with director Tharun Moorthy after the success of 'Thudarum'. Producer Antony Perumbavoor has now offered a glimpse into the expectations viewers should have for the project.In a recent media interaction, Antony Perumbavoor cautioned viewers against assuming that 'Athimanoharam' would follow the style of 'Narasimham' simply because Mohanlal appears twirling his moustache. He also stressed that audiences should approach it as a Tharun Moorthy directorial.Antony Perumbavoor on expectations surrounding 'Athimanoharam'Speaking about the film, Antony Perumbavoor expressed his hope that the project would achieve significant success. He also said the team was praying for that outcome.Addressing comparisons with Mohanlal's earlier films, the producer said, as quoted by Reporter website, “We are hoping for the biggest success. May that happen; we are praying for it. Just because he comes in twirling his moustache, nobody should expect a film like 'Narasimham'. They should expect a Tharun Moorthy film featuring a moustache-twirling character.”Project initially announced as 'L365'The film's development also involved a change in director. The project was initially announced under the title 'L365', with Austin Dan Thomas attached as the director. Ratheesh Ravi was announced as the screenwriter, while the first poster featured an image of a police uniform. Austin Dan Thomas subsequently exited the project. The film was later announced as 'L366', with Tharun Moorthy taking over as director.Tharun Moorthy reunites with Mohanlal after 'Thudarum''Athimanoharam' marks another collaboration between Mohanlal and Tharun Moorthy following 'Thudarum', which received good reviews from the audiences and was a blockbuster.Meanwhile, Shaji Kumar, who worked as the cinematographer on 'Thudarum', is handling the camera work for 'Athimanoharam'. Jakes Bejoy is composing the music, while Vivek Harshan is responsible for editing. Gokul Das has been brought on board as the art director. articles.title: Serie A Preview: Milan vs Inter – Team News, Lineups & Prediction
articles.summary: One of the most interesting fixtures in the Serie A calendar takes place at San Siro this weekend as Milan take on their fiercest rivals, Inter. The latest e...
articles.body:
One of the most interesting fixtures in the Serie A calendar takes place at San Siro this weekend as Milan take on their fiercest rivals, Inter. The latest edition of the famous Derby della Madonnina could already determine the fate of Milan's faint title hopes.

Despite going unbeaten in his first eight league games in charge of Milan (W5, D3), Ruben Amorim is responsible for the club's second-weakest start to the season since 2019/20. Only 18 points from the opening nine rounds left the Rossoneri seven points adrift of joint leaders Inter and Lazio ahead of the weekend.

With that in mind, anything other than a win in this mouth-watering showdown would likely spell the end of Milan's pursuit of their landmark 20th Scudetto. However, it's easier said than done, especially given Inter's form heading into this meeting. Cristian Chivu's men have enjoyed a near-flawless start to their title defense.

Inter left it late to beat out-of-sorts Venezia in midweek Serie A action, as two own goals from the Winged Lions beyond the 75th minute propelled them to a 2-0 victory. The Nerazzurri have dropped points once so far this season (W8, D1) and are currently level on points with Lazio and four clear of third-placed Roma.

Amorim's unbeaten Serie A record ended abruptly on Wednesday as Bologna thrashed Milan 4-2 at San Siro despite trailing by a goal at halftime. Raffaele Palladino's side brutally exposed Milan's defensive frailties, which have seen the Rossoneri concede at least two goals in three of their last four games across all competitions.

San Siro has been anything but a fortress this term, with two of Amorim's three defeats at the helm coming at this stadium (W3). If it's any consolation, Milan have scored two or more goals in four of their five competitive home outings in 2026/27, except for a dismal 2-0 loss to Benfica in the Europa League.

Further confidence could come from the fact that Milan have only lost one of their last 13 home league matches in this kick-off slot (W7, D5). Upholding that promising trend is not beyond the realm of possibility despite their recent struggles, given that the Rossoneri are enjoying their longest unbeaten run in this fixture in more than 20 years.

Though it sounds somewhat paradoxical, Inter have failed to beat Milan in their last seven meetings in all competitions (D2, L5), losing both Serie A encounters last season by a goal to nil. Keen to buck that frustrating trend, the reigning Scudetto holders head into proceedings on the back of their best league start since 1988/89.

Chivu's charges have developed a 'never give up' mentality that puts them in the driver's seat here. For context, they've won a league-high 13 points from losing positions this season (W4, D1), suggesting that no one should dare to write them off even if they concede first in this derby.

Inter have also been too hot to handle in the final third, netting 25 Serie A goals in nine matches, more than any other team. Furthermore, they've been ruthless at San Siro this season, winning all five competitive home matches, which also bodes well, even though they're the designated away side.

Samuel Chukwueze, Mattia Gabbia, Alexis Saelemaekers, and Ruben Loftus-Cheek will not be at Amorim's disposal on Saturday. However, Diego Moreira, Adrien Rabiot, and Mario Gila could return to the squad after missing the match against Bologna, with the former likely to take Davide Bartesaghi's place on the left wing.

As for Inter, long-term absentees John Stones, Curtis Jones, Luis Henrique, and Benjamin Pavard remain on the sidelines. Yet, the absence of captain Lautaro Martinez is the heaviest blow, with Ange-Yoan Bonny expected to replace him in attack at the expense of Francesco Pio Esposito.

Milan vs Inter Potential Starting Lineups

Milan (4-2-3-1): Maignan; Tomori, De Winter, Pavlovic, Estupinan; Musah, Jashari; Hutchinson, Cisse, Moreira; Ramos.

Inter (3-5-2): Provedel, Augusto, Bisseck, Bastoni; Diouf, Zielenski, Stankovic, Sucic, Dimarco; Bonny, Thuram.

Despite Inter's superior form and attacking firepower, Milan's impressive record in this fixture makes the Derby della Madonnina difficult to call. Amorim's side have struggled defensively in recent weeks, but the potential returns of Rabiot, Moreira, and Gila could provide a timely boost.

A share of the spoils could be on the cards.
